nodes.name: Introduction
nodes.content: Skill generation needs source-grounded validation. This poster summarizes the motivation for verifier-gated generated skills.

nodes.name: Method
nodes.content: We build a verifier-gated skill selection pipeline. The method keeps evidence identifiers attached to generated skills.

nodes.name: Results
nodes.content: The baseline ablation completed successfully. The result section records the main evidence for the generated skill claim.
